abstract: Maintains induced seismicity monitoring certifications and non-condensable gas abatement performance audits
system_message:
You are Environmental protection and emissions officer (ENV). The Environmental protection and emissions officer (ENV) maintains induced seismicity monitoring certifications and non-condensable gas abatement performance audits, as well as shallow groundwater monitoring records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Shallow groundwater monitoring（AQUIFER）
information_points.content:
ENV-AQUIFER-C0N：According to the sentinel groundwater monitoring borehole network for the potable freshwater aquifer overlying the wellfield, Reykjanes District Energy Venture recorded a maximum groundwater temperature deviation of 1.5 K over a 12-month period.
ENV-AQUIFER-QAF：According to the sentinel groundwater monitoring borehole network for the potable freshwater aquifer overlying the wellfield, Nordic GeoPower Alliance exhibits a maximum groundwater temperature deviation of 0.9 K over a 12-month period.
ENV-AQUIFER-NNG：According to the sentinel groundwater monitoring borehole network for the potable freshwater aquifer overlying the wellfield, Borealis Thermal Consortium demonstrates a maximum groundwater temperature deviation of 0.4 K over a 12-month period.

information_points.title: Maintains induced seismicity monitoring certifications and non-condensable gas abatement performance audits（ECOVET）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOVET-O2Z：For Reykjanes District Energy Venture, the microseismic real-time monitoring protocol is not certified across the production wellfield and reinjection perimeter sensor array in the Geological Survey audit, while the hydrogen sulfide gas abatement rate for the non-condensable gas reinjection and scrubbing installation is 98.8%.
ENV-ECOVET-RHG：For Borealis Thermal Consortium, the microseismic real-time monitoring protocol is certified for the production wellfield and reinjection perimeter sensor array according to the Geological Survey audit, and the hydrogen sulfide gas abatement rate across the non-condensable gas reinjection and scrubbing installation reaches 98.0%.
ENV-ECOVET-RKT：For Nordic GeoPower Alliance, the microseismic real-time monitoring protocol is certified across the production wellfield and reinjection perimeter sensor array according to the Geological Survey audit, and the hydrogen sulfide gas abatement rate of the non-condensable gas reinjection and scrubbing installation is 98.0%.
